description: PMH-T-S80 sand cover tape is made by using the cross-laminated film as the carrier, coating the pressure sensitive adhesive on the upper and lower surfaces, and top side covering weather resistant particles. The bottom side of the tape after peeling off release liner, has a highly aggressive PSA which is designed to adhere to PMH 3080/PMH 3080 PLUS membrane.
whereToUse: sealing of mechanically fastened penetration covers
It is a very important accessory to PMH 3080/PMH 3080 PLUS membrane
suitable for various underground waterproofing projects
notFor: Contractors must undergo training before starting work
During construction, it is strictly forbidden to stick the cover tape in rainy and snowy days or in winds of level 5 or higher

The environment temperature for cold application of self-adhesive membranes and tapes should not be lower than 5°C (this includes storage, construction, and the 24 hours following the completion of installation)
Prior to applying the tape to the membrane, ensure that the bonding surface is clean and free of dust, moisture, or contaminants
After overlapping, firmly roll or press along the seam to achieve continuous, uniform adhesion and ensure watertight integrity
storage: Do not allow contact with acids, alkalis, oils, and organic solvents. The number of stacking layers of the packing box should not exceed four. Under normal transportation and storage conditions, the storage period is one year from the production date.
